Sales & Customer Operations

From first quotation to final receipt. One customer record, one order pipeline, one invoice register — connected to inventory and accounting in real time.

Who this is for

Sales managers, account executives, cashiers, and business owners who need visibility of the entire sales cycle — from quotation to collection. Whether you sell from a counter, through field agents, or via online orders, this module handles the transaction and keeps the ledger current.

What you can do

Quotations & Sales Orders

Create quotations, convert to sales orders, and generate invoices. Track quotation-to-order conversion rates. Support partial deliveries and backorders.

Customer Invoices

Generate invoices with tax calculations, discounts, and multi-currency support. Print or email to customers. Track outstanding balances and payment status.

Delivery Notes

Confirm deliveries against sales orders. Stock is deducted automatically on delivery confirmation. Generate delivery note printouts for dispatch.

Customer Management

Maintain a customer master with contacts, credit limits, payment terms, price lists, and statement preferences. View customer history, outstanding balances, and transaction ledger.

Point of Sale

Touch-optimised POS terminal for retail and hospitality. Supports cash, mobile money, and card payments. Barcode scanning. Multi-terminal per branch. End-of-day cash reconciliation.

Sales CRM

Leads and opportunities pipeline. Interaction logging. Contact management. Sales forecasting. Quotation conversion tracking. Performance analytics by rep, territory, and product.

Agent Management

Register field sales agents. Assign territories and targets. Track daily sales per agent. Calculate commissions (flat rate, tiered, product-specific). Agents view their own performance through the self-service portal.

Territory Management

Define sales territories. Assign agents and customers to territories. Track sales performance by territory. Generate territory-level reports.

How it connects

  • Inventory → stock deducted on delivery confirmation, stock checked on order entry
  • Accounting → revenue and debtor entries posted on invoice approval
  • Procurement → backorders trigger purchase requests
  • Sales Agents → agent stock, commissions, and remittances managed separately
